blurb: Usher, TLC, Outkast, Missy Elliott, Lauryn Hill and Warren G, played as one long set by a six-piece band with the verses rapped live, so a crowd that grew up on this music ends up on the floor singing every word. Little Moses Jones brings its own sound engineer, plays a clean show when the night calls for one, and books for holiday parties, galas, weddings and milestone birthdays in Denver and across Colorado.
_identity_note: Written 2026-10-29 in the Signet voice from the facts on their site, EPK and channel, and read aloud against AI-TELLS layers 3 to 8: no epigram ender, no fragment stack, no not-X-but-Y, no colon reveal, contractions throughout, one setting per sentence. identity: Two singers work the front of Little Moses Jones, and behind them the bandleader plays keys and horns over guitar, bass and drums. The set runs straight through with no gap between the songs, so nobody leaves the floor to wait for the next one.

The song list runs Usher, TLC, Destiny's Child, Mary J. Blige, Outkast, Missy Elliott, Nelly and Montell Jordan, with the soul and funk records those songs came from threaded through it, and the set on the night is built for the crowd in front of it. They play a clean version of the show for an office party or a gala and the full version for a late night, so the same band suits both.

The band has nearly two decades of live work behind it. It has played for Google, Pearson and a Denver Broncos pregame, galas for the Boys and Girls Club and the Denver Children's Foundation, festival stages at Parker Days, Burro Days and Juneteenth in Thornton, and dates in Amsterdam and Mexico. In 2022 the LUXlife awards named it Colorado's wedding band of the year.
It books as a six piece with its own sound engineer, so there's no separate audio company to hire, and it's a Denver band that plays the Front Range and the mountain towns.
